messages:
elena: Heads-up — KMS audit shows a decrypt call at 09:12 UTC by service-principal from org:beta but the key is owned by org:alpha. Not expected.
ops-bot: ALERT: kms.decrypt by sp://svc-ingest@org-beta on key alpha/km/2025-09 detected (rule: cross-org-decrypt).
paul: omg — is this a permissions thing or a routing bug?
sam: Could be the RBAC refactor we shipped yesterday (PR #5423). That changed how role inheritance is applied across org/project boundaries.
maggie: I remember we relaxed the org -> project deny precedence so project roles could override org denies. That was intentional for some onboarding flows.
elena: Right but audit indicates a principal from beta had ROLE_PROJECT_EDITOR on a project in alpha due to a group mapping. That allowed KMS access through a project-level binding.
jordan: Can someone paste the exact policy blob and the binding that matched?
paul: Quick reproducer query: ```sql
-- find principals with decrypt on alpha keys
SELECT p.principal, b.binding_id, b.scope, b.role
FROM bindings b
JOIN principals p ON p.id = b.principal_id
WHERE b.resource = 'alpha/km/2025-09' AND b.privileges @> ARRAY['kms:decrypt'];
```
sam: Found a binding: binding_id=7892, scope=project:alpha/ingest, role=project_editor, principal=group:analytics-beta. That group's org is beta.
maggie: So group membership mapping allowed cross-org group to be attached to a project in another org. That mapping came from the "org-affinity" auto-linker change in PR #5398.
elena: Root cause hypothesis: when we created project bindings we didn't enforce that principal.org == binding_project.org unless the principal is a global service account. The new inheritance rules let project-level grants override org-level denies.
jordan: Immediate mitigation: 1) rollback PR #5398 to stop new cross-org links 2) remove binding 7892 3) rotate the KMS key material for alpha/km/2025-09 4) list and revoke any issued session tokens created under that principal.
paul: I'll take 1 & 2. Rolling back the auto-linker now.
sam: I'll draft a short incident notice for customers with affected projects (alpha). Keep wording minimal: "We are investigating an access misconfiguration — no evidence of data exfil so far."
maggie: Policy fix idea: enforce tenant-scoped principal validation in policy engine: require binding.principal.org == binding.resource.org OR principal.trust == 'global'. Add unit tests.
elena: Also add an explicit deny evaluator that wins even if project role grants exist when resource.tenant != principal.tenant. That prevents override loopholes.
jordan: Forensics: attach logs from 09:00-09:30 UTC and run `select * from audit.kms where request_time between ...` — we should capture session ids and IPs.
paul: Logs attached to the incident runbook. Found one session with IP 18.205.12.3; looks like internal infra, not external.
sam: We need an end-to-end regression test before unrolling the RBAC refactor: simulate group mapping across two orgs and ensure decrypt is denied. Add to infra-e2e nightly.
maggie: Will add a unit test in policy-evaluator: `test_cross_tenant_binding_is_denied()` and integrate into GH action.
elena: Postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, mitigations, customer impact, key rotation done, follow-up PRs (#5477 policy-scoped-enforcer, #5481 unit-tests).
ops-bot: INCIDENT: tickets created - #INC-1129 (rotation), #INC-1130 (rollback), #INC-1131 (customer-notice).
jordan: Assigning owners: paul -> rollback & binding cleanup, elena -> forensics & customer comms, maggie -> policy change & tests, sam -> postmortem writeup.
elena: Thanks. After rotation + revoke we'll re-run the audit queries and confirm no further decrypts. Then schedule a 1-hr blameless review at 16:00 UTC. :eyes:
sam: Also add an explicit metric/alert on cross-tenant KMS decrypts so ops-bot will page next time.
maggie: Noted — I'll add rule to detections.
paul: Running rollback now. Will update thread when done.
elena: update: rollback applied, binding 7892 removed, key scheduled for rotation (ETA 20m).
jordan: Good work team. Keep incremental status here and attach the final postmortem link when ready.
